items.label: GET /Health
items.summary: Added FND-001: GET /Health returns 200 with {status:healthy}, unauthenticated liveness endpoint.

items.label: GET /v1/supported_assets
items.summary: Added ASSET-001..003: GET /supported_assets lists active assets with id/name/symbol/decimals/type/contract/nativeAsset; unpaginated.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/assets
items.summary: Added ASSET-004..006: GET /vault/assets aggregates wallet balances per asset (balance, locked, available as F18 strings).

items.label: GET /v1/vault/assets/{assetId}
items.summary: Added ASSET-007..008: GET /vault/assets/{assetId} returns asset metadata by id; missing id raises not-found via error middleware.

items.label: GET /v1/estimate_network_fee
items.summary: Added TXN-004..005: GET /estimate_network_fee returns 404 for unknown asset; otherwise fixed low/medium/high fee estimates (feePerByte/gasPrice/networkFee/baseFee/priorityFee).

items.label: POST /v1/transactions
items.summary: Added TXN-006..013: POST /transactions validates workspace/source/asset/amount/externalTxId uniqueness; auto-creates source/dest wallets+addresses; validates external address format; persists SUBMITTED txn with hash, fees, initiatedBy, gross-amount handling; reserves funds; notifies realtime.

items.label: GET /v1/transactions
items.summary: Added TXN-014: GET /transactions requires workspace; filters by status/txHash/before/after (ms epoch), limit (default 200), ordered by createdAt desc; results scoped to workspace addresses.

items.label: GET /v1/transactions/{txId}
items.summary: Added TXN-015: GET /transactions/{txId} resolves by internal id within workspace (no external id fallback), includes VaultAccount, raises not-found if absent, returns Fireblocks DTO with address ownership metadata.

items.label: GET /v1/transactions/external_tx_id/{externalTxId}
items.summary: Added TXN-016: GET /transactions/external_tx_id/{externalTxId} resolves by ExternalTxId within workspace address filter, includes VaultAccount, returns Fireblocks DTO with address ownership; not-found if absent.

items.label: POST /v1/transactions/{txId}/cancel
items.summary: Added TXN-017: POST /transactions/{txId}/cancel resolves by id/externalId in workspace; rejects terminal states; sets CANCELLED+SubStatus CANCELLED_BY_USER; notifies realtime; returns success.

items.label: POST /v1/transactions/{txId}/freeze
items.summary: Added TXN-018: POST /transactions/{txId}/freeze resolves by id/externalId in workspace, calls Freeze(), persists, fans out realtime transactionsUpdated, returns success.

items.label: POST /v1/transactions/{txId}/unfreeze
items.summary: Added TXN-019: POST /transactions/{txId}/unfreeze resolves by id/externalId in workspace, calls Unfreeze(), persists, fans out realtime transactionsUpdated, returns success.

items.label: POST /v1/transactions/{txId}/drop
items.summary: Added TXN-020: POST /transactions/{txId}/drop ETH-only, non-terminal; marks orig CANCELLED/DROPPED_BY_BLOCKCHAIN; creates SUBMITTED replacement with +20% fee, new hash; links ReplacedByTxId; notifies.

items.label: POST /v1/transactions/estimate_fee
items.summary: Added TXN-021: POST /transactions/estimate_fee returns low/medium/high (1x/1.5x/2.5x of asset BaseFee); BTC/ADA feePerByte+networkFee; SOL networkFee only; others gasPrice/baseFee/priorityFee/gasLimit.

items.label: GET /v1/transactions/validate_address/{assetId}/{address}
items.summary: Added TXN-022: GET /transactions/validate_address/{assetId}/{address} validates asset exists; BTC prefix/ETH-USDT-USDC 0x+42; returns isValid/isActive/requiresTag (MemoBased).

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts
items.summary: Added VAULT-001: POST /vault/accounts requires workspace; creates VaultAccount with GUID id, name/customerRefId/autoFuel/hiddenOnUI (default false), timestamps; emits vaultsUpdated; returns DTO.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts
items.summary: Added VAULT-002: GET /vault/accounts requires workspace; returns unpaginated list of vault accounts in workspace with wallet-derived assets (F18 balance/locked/available).

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts_paged
items.summary: Added VAULT-003: GET /vault/accounts_paged orders by Id asc with before/after cursor and limit (default 100); filters namePrefix/nameSuffix/assetId/minAmountThreshold; paging.before/after only when page is full.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}
items.summary: Added VAULT-004: GET /vault/accounts/{id} returns workspace-scoped vault with wallets mapped to Fireblocks DTO; not-found if missing or in another workspace.

items.label: PUT /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}
items.summary: Added VAULT-005: PUT /vault/accounts/{id} updates only name (and UpdatedAt) for workspace-scoped vault; not-found if missing; emits vaultsUpdated; returns updated DTO.

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/hide
items.summary: Added VAULT-006: POST /vault/accounts/{id}/hide sets HiddenOnUI=true on workspace-scoped vault (not-found if missing); refreshes UpdatedAt; emits vaultsUpdated; returns DTO.

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/unhide
items.summary: Added VAULT-007: POST /vault/accounts/{id}/unhide sets HiddenOnUI=false on workspace-scoped vault (not-found if missing); refreshes UpdatedAt; emits vaultsUpdated; returns DTO.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}/addresses
items.summary: Added VAULT-008: GET /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId}/addresses requires workspace; validates vault+asset; returns workspace-scoped wallet addresses mapped to DTO (assetId, address, description, tag, type, customerRefId, addressFormat default BASE, legacyAddress, enterpriseAddress, bip44AddressIndex); empty list if wallet missing.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}/addresses_paginated
items.summary: Added VAULT-009: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId}/addresses_paginated cursor-paginated by BIP44 index; auto-generates primary address if wallet exists with none; before/after parsed as int indices; pageSize=count?:limit(default 100); paging.before=first index, paging.after=last only when page full.

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}/addresses
items.summary: Added VAULT-010: POST /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId}/addresses requires workspace; missing wallet/asset -> not-found; creates address with optional description/customerRefId via service; returns address/legacyAddress/enterpriseAddress/tag/bip44AddressIndex.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}
items.summary: Added VAULT-011: GET /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId} returns workspace-scoped wallet mapped to VaultAssetDto with G29-formatted total/balance/available (balance-locked-frozen)/pending/frozen/lockedAmount/staked; blockHeight default '100', blockHash default 'xxyy'; not-found if missing.

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}
items.summary: Added VAULT-012: POST /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId} requires workspace; validates vault+asset; per BlockchainType: AddressBased/MemoBased create new address on existing wallet; AccountBased returns existing as-is; new wallet zero-balanced with primary address ensured; response Status='READY', empty activationTxId, echoes eosAccountName.

items.label: POST /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}/balance
items.summary: Added VAULT-013: POST /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId}/balance requires workspace; not-found if wallet missing; only updates UpdatedAt (no real balance recompute) and returns wallet DTO.

items.label: GET /v1/vault/accounts/{vaultAccountId}/{assetId}/unspent_inputs
items.summary: Added VAULT-014: GET /vault/accounts/{id}/{assetId}/unspent_inputs (no workspace scoping in controller); not-found if wallet missing; always returns empty list (UTXO simulation not implemented).

items.label: GET /admin/addresses/generate
items.summary: Added ADM-ADDR-001: GET /admin/addresses/generate requires workspace and non-empty assetId (ASSET_REQUIRED); generates external address; appends memo tag when asset is MemoBased.

items.label: GET /admin/assets
items.summary: Added ADM-ASSET-001: GET /admin/assets returns all assets (active+inactive) ordered by AssetId asc; unpaginated AdminAssetDto list.

items.label: POST /admin/assets
items.summary: Added ADM-ASSET-002: POST /admin/assets validates required assetId/name/symbol (normalized upper-invariant), unique assetId, blockchainType enum (default AccountBased), decimals>=0 (default 18), baseFee>=0 (default 0); trims optional text/ids; defaults isCaseSensitive/isActive true; stamps CreatedAt.

items.label: PATCH /admin/assets/{id}
items.summary: Added ADM-ASSET-003: PATCH /admin/assets/{id} partial update on non-null fields applying same validation as create; not-found if missing.

items.label: DELETE /admin/assets/{id}
items.summary: Added ADM-ASSET-004: DELETE /admin/assets/{id} soft-deletes by setting IsActive=false (row retained); not-found if missing; returns data:true.

items.label: GET /admin/settings/auto-transitions
items.summary: Added ADM-SET-001: GET /admin/settings/auto-transitions requires workspace; returns workspace's AutoTransitionEnabled flag; WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND for missing/soft-deleted.

items.label: POST /admin/settings/auto-transitions
items.summary: Added ADM-SET-002: POST /admin/settings/auto-transitions updates workspace AutoTransitionEnabled, refreshes UpdatedAt, echoes settings; WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND for missing/soft-deleted.

items.summary: AUTH-001 added: resolves WorkspaceContext per request; anonymous for OPTIONS/health/swagger/supported_assets/transactions/estimate_fee; admin/workspaces anonymous, other /admin/* uses X-Workspace-Id w/ fallback to oldest workspace; /vault & /transactions require X-API-Key or Authorization (else 401 raw JSON); X-API-Key validated against ApiKeys (non-deleted workspace), Bearer-only is unvalidated test-mode.

items.label: FireblocksErrorMapperMiddleware (maps exceptions to Fireblocks error format)
items.summary: FND-004 added: outermost catch-all serialises ErrorResponse{message,code} camelCase; DbUpdateException w/ IX_Transactions_ExternalTxId UniqueViolation->409/1438; FireblocksApiException passthrough; ArgumentException/InvalidOperationException->400; UnauthorizedAccess->401; KeyNotFound->404; otherwise 500.

items.label: HttpTrafficLoggingMiddleware (request/response logging)
items.summary: FND-005 added: logs method/path/status/elapsed/TraceId + redacted headers (Authorization/Cookie/X-API-Key) + truncated 32 KiB text bodies; skips body for binary; WS upgrade emits placeholder; level Error on 5xx/exception, Warning on 4xx, else Info.
